# Capstone 3: sysmon, a System Monitor

`sysmon` is a lightweight cross-platform system monitoring utility. It gathers operating system telemetry—CPU core utilization, memory breakdown, swap stats, disk usage, and top active processes—and renders either a real-time terminal dashboard or a periodic JSON metric stream.

## Dependencies

```toml
[package]
name = "sysmon"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"

[dependencies]
sysinfo = "0.30"
clap = { version = "4.5", features = ["derive"] }
serde = { version = "1.0", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1.0"
anyhow = "1.0"
```

## System Telemetry Engine

```rust
use sysinfo::System;
use serde::Serialize;

#[derive(Serialize, Debug)]
pub struct SystemSnapshot {
    pub total_memory_mb: u64,
    pub used_memory_mb: u64,
    pub global_cpu_usage: f32,
    pub process_count: usize,
    pub top_processes: Vec<ProcessMetric>,
}

#[derive(Serialize, Debug)]
pub struct ProcessMetric {
    pub pid: u32,
    pub name: String,
    pub memory_mb: u64,
    pub cpu_usage: f32,
}

pub fn collect_snapshot(sys: &mut System) -> SystemSnapshot {
    sys.refresh_all();

    let total_memory_mb = sys.total_memory() / (1024 * 1024);
    let used_memory_mb = sys.used_memory() / (1024 * 1024);
    let global_cpu_usage = sys.global_cpu_info().cpu_usage();

    let mut processes: Vec<_> = sys.processes()
        .iter()
        .map(|(pid, proc_info)| ProcessMetric {
            pid: pid.as_u32(),
            name: proc_info.name().to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
            memory_mb: proc_info.memory() / (1024 * 1024),
            cpu_usage: proc_info.cpu_usage(),
        })
        .collect();

    // Sort by CPU consumption descending
    processes.sort_by(|a, b| b.cpu_usage.partial_cmp(&a.cpu_usage).unwrap());
    processes.truncate(5);

    SystemSnapshot {
        total_memory_mb,
        used_memory_mb,
        global_cpu_usage,
        process_count: sys.processes().len(),
        top_processes: processes,
    }
}
```

## Periodic Observation Loop

```rust
use std::thread;
use std::time::Duration;

fn main() {
    let mut sys = System::new_all();

    loop {
        let snapshot = collect_snapshot(&mut sys);
        let json = serde_json::to_string(&snapshot).unwrap();
        println!("{json}");
        thread::sleep(Duration::from_secs(2));
    }
}
```
